high_level_description: This image captures a person taking a selfie in an outdoor setting. The individual is wearing a black shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows, and they have a colorful crossbody bag over their shoulder. They are holding a white water bottle in their right hand. The person has short dark hair and a beard. The background features a scenic landscape with a sign that reads "Slide Rock Market." The market sign includes an illustration of apples and a green border. Behind the sign, there is a grassy area leading up to a forested hillside.
